[BBC Business] Three things we've learnt about the UK economy from the IMF

[BBC Business] Poundland in rescue talks as owners seek buyer

[BBC Business] BA flight forced to turn back over cracked window

[CNBC] Airport attacks put aviation in crosshairs of geopolitical conflicts

[CNBC] JPMorgan Chase blocks outside AI agents like Muse, Instinct from directly accessing accounts

[MarketWatch] Fake shopping sprees and ‘happiness insurance’: The latest fintech apps reveal our financial anxieties

[MarketWatch] New SEC rules would fleece everyday investors to enrich Wall Street
New proposals from the Securities and Exchange Commission will tilt the scales in favor of Wall Street and against a huge group of retail investors.
